---
title: "Minimal I4R verification fixture"
output: html_document
---

This sanitized fixture illustrates the four explicit outcomes. Production notebooks are generated
by `scripts/make_verification_notebook.sh`; rendered HTML and result CSVs are outputs and are not
distributed as skill context.

```{r setup}
results <- list()
record <- function(claim, expected, observed, verdict, detail = "") {
  results[[length(results) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
    claim, expected = as.character(expected), observed = as.character(observed), verdict, detail)
}
```

## C-1 — deterministic result

```{r C_1}
expected <- 42                 # state before computation
observed <- sum(c(20, 22))
record("C-1", expected, observed,
       if (identical(expected, observed)) "PASS" else "FAIL")
```

## C-2 — judgement

```{r C_2}
record("C-2", "explicit assessment", "evidence reviewed", "JUDGEMENT",
       "The basis must be stated so another verifier can disagree on the merits.")
```

## C-3 — unverifiable

```{r C_3}
record("C-3", "deposited input", "input absent", "UNVERIFIABLE",
       "Name what was sought, what was attempted, and how the absence limits the claim.")
```

```{r summary}
table <- do.call(rbind, results)
knitr::kable(table)
utils::write.csv(table, "verification_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
failures <- sum(table$verdict == "FAIL")
writeLines(as.character(as.integer(failures > 0)), "verification_status.txt")
if (failures) stop("verification failed")
```
